entries.name: Clear and direct expression
entries.scope: State observations, reasoning, feelings, needs, requests, and boundaries without hints or unnecessary complexity.
entries.evidence_of_progress: A difficult message is understood without requiring others to decode it.

measurement.minimum_standard: Use at least two independent evidence types, including one behavioral, observer, artifact, objective, or longitudinal indicator; self-report alone is insufficient for score advancement.

entries.name: Nonverbal communication
entries.scope: Read and use posture, facial expression, eye contact, distance, gesture, pace, and tone cautiously and contextually.
entries.evidence_of_progress: Uses nonverbal cues to inform—not replace—direct clarification.

measurement.minimum_standard: Use at least two independent evidence types, including one behavioral, observer, artifact, objective, or longitudinal indicator; self-report alone is insufficient for score advancement.

entries.name: One-to-one and group conversation
entries.scope: Initiate, sustain, balance, transition, include, and close conversations in different settings.
entries.evidence_of_progress: Conversations feel reciprocal rather than interrogative, dominating, or absent.

measurement.minimum_standard: Use at least two independent evidence types, including one behavioral, observer, artifact, objective, or longitudinal indicator; self-report alone is insufficient for score advancement.

entries.name: Perspective taking and empathic accuracy
entries.scope: Imagine another viewpoint while checking assumptions against what the person actually reports.
entries.evidence_of_progress: Can represent another perspective fairly without pretending to know their inner state.

measurement.minimum_standard: Use at least two independent evidence types, including one behavioral, observer, artifact, objective, or longitudinal indicator; self-report alone is insufficient for score advancement.

entries.name: Audience and context adaptation
entries.scope: Adjust language, detail, medium, timing, emotion, culture, role, and urgency.
entries.evidence_of_progress: Communicates the same core idea effectively to materially different audiences.

measurement.minimum_standard: Use at least two independent evidence types, including one behavioral, observer, artifact, objective, or longitudinal indicator; self-report alone is insufficient for score advancement.

entries.name: Feedback and developmental conversation
entries.scope: Give specific, timely, actionable feedback and receive criticism without collapse or automatic defense.
entries.evidence_of_progress: Both parties leave knowing what should continue, change, and be reviewed.

measurement.minimum_standard: Use at least two independent evidence types, including one behavioral, observer, artifact, objective, or longitudinal indicator; self-report alone is insufficient for score advancement.

entries.name: Classical and modern rhetoric
entries.scope: Understand ethos, pathos, logos, framing, narrative, evidence, repetition, medium, and audience psychology.
entries.evidence_of_progress: Can analyze persuasion and create an argument without concealing material truth.

measurement.minimum_standard: Use at least two independent evidence types, including one behavioral, observer, artifact, objective, or longitudinal indicator; self-report alone is insufficient for score advancement.

entries.name: Public speaking and presentation
entries.scope: Structure, rehearse, deliver, adapt, and respond to an audience with clarity and composure.
entries.evidence_of_progress: Can deliver a coherent talk and improve it using observed audience response.

measurement.minimum_standard: Use at least two independent evidence types, including one behavioral, observer, artifact, objective, or longitudinal indicator; self-report alone is insufficient for score advancement.

entries.name: Storytelling and explanation
entries.scope: Use sequence, character, tension, example, analogy, and resolution to make meaning memorable.
entries.evidence_of_progress: A listener can retell the essential message accurately.

measurement.minimum_standard: Use at least two independent evidence types, including one behavioral, observer, artifact, objective, or longitudinal indicator; self-report alone is insufficient for score advancement.

entries.name: Negotiation
entries.scope: Identify interests, alternatives, leverage, constraints, fairness, trades, and walk-away conditions.
entries.evidence_of_progress: Reaches a better agreement or principled refusal than reactive bargaining would produce.

measurement.minimum_standard: Use at least two independent evidence types, including one behavioral, observer, artifact, objective, or longitudinal indicator; self-report alone is insufficient for score advancement.

entries.name: Conflict and de-escalation
entries.scope: Recognize escalation, regulate self, clarify issues, own contributions, reduce threat, and define next steps.
entries.evidence_of_progress: A conflict becomes safer and more solvable, or is ended with clear boundaries.

measurement.minimum_standard: Use at least two independent evidence types, including one behavioral, observer, artifact, objective, or longitudinal indicator; self-report alone is insufficient for score advancement.

entries.name: Humor, warmth, and social ease
entries.scope: Use playfulness, timing, self-awareness, and kindness without humiliation or compulsive performance.
entries.evidence_of_progress: Humor increases connection or relief rather than making another person the cost.
